topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: The rain's a constant tap on the window, matching the rhythm of my入境 thoughts. Got a call today, the kind you don’t want. You know, the one where the voice on the other end’s soft, apologetic. The surprise, they said, it’s not happening. Just a mix-up, they said. But I’ve heard that tone before, the one that rings hollow, even through the static. I thought I’d finally have a night where the cards fell my way, just once. Looks like I played the hand wrong again. The city’s got a million faces, and tonight, it’s grinning at me in the dark. I can practically hear it laughing.
